record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare SPIN_OUT (passive ACCELERATION, maxPP 80, range 1, types STEEL/ARTIFICIAL/POISON). The strategy is shared; they differ in stars (1 and 2) and stats.
record.summary: Speed-scaled hit, blind, retreat and stack reset. After the base process (PP spent), the strategy requests handleSpecialDamage on the cast target with damage = round(coefficient x the caster's current speed), coefficient [0.25, 0.5, 1, 2] by caster stars (VAROOM 0.25, REVAVROOM 0.5), SPECIAL type, the cast crit flag and the default AP boost; then triggers Blinded for a requested 1000 ms on the target (origin: the caster, not AP-boosted; skipped if already blinded or under Rune Protect; halved if the target is enraged; reduced by the target's status duration reductions). It then picks an own-side corner destination (board.getTeleportationCell: the empty cells on the supercover lines from the caster to the two own-side back corners, the one farthest by Chebyshev distance from the caster); if one exists, a 100 ms DelayedCommand moves the caster there with moveTo(..., false) (swapping with whatever stands on that cell at that moment). Finally it finds the caster's AccelerationEffect and, if present, requests addSpeed(-15 x stacks) (apBoost 0) and sets the stacks to 0. The damage is computed before the reset, so it uses the speed including the stacks. No heal, shield or PP effect.

targeting.who: the cast target (damage and Blinded); the caster itself (retreat and speed reset)
targeting.note: The destination is chosen at cast time from empty cells only, but the move happens 100 ms later, when the chosen cell may be occupied; moveTo then swaps with the occupant. If no empty cell exists on the lines, no move is queued.

geometry.shape: single target for the hit; the retreat destination is the empty cell farthest from the caster (Chebyshev) on the supercover lines to the caster's two own-side back corners

effects.scaling: requested = round(coefficient x pokemon.speed) (speed read at cast time, including ACCELERATION stacks of +15 each and any other speed change), then x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost default true), then x (1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction) when the cast crit flag is true (rolled only with ABILITY_CRIT because canCritByDefault is false). The table has no fallback: a star count above 4 would give NaN (not reachable by the listed units).
effects.resolution: applied: returns takenDamage 0 for a target with protect, skydiving or magicBounce (magicBounce may reflect); otherwise PokemonState.handleDamage divides SPECIAL damage by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) with the floor of 1, shield first (core-mechanics sections A, H and J1: the returned takenDamage counts shield damage). The strategy ignores the result; the Blinded call after it is unconditional on the damage result.

effects.scaling: requested = -15 x accelerationStacks, not scaled by AP or crit (addSpeed called with apBoost 0 and the caster as its own source).
effects.resolution: applied: addSpeed first runs applyBigEaterBeltStatBuff (own-team negative value x1.25 rounded down for a Big Eater Belt holder, so -15 per stack becomes more than 15 lost) then applyTwistBandBuff (no flip: the caster is on its own team), a MELMETAL passive is redirected to attack (not relevant here), and the result is clamped to 0..MAX_SPEED. Stacks are then set to 0 regardless of the applied change, so with a belt more speed than was gained can be removed. If the caster has no AccelerationEffect no speed change is requested.

applied: moveTo(x, y, board, false) after 100 ms: toMovingState on the caster (and the occupant, if any), swapCells with whatever is on the destination, caster cooldown set to 100. Not a forced displacement, so canBeMoved is not checked. The swap uses setEntityOnCell, which updates board effects on the caster. The move does not itself pass through the moving-state step, so it is not seen to add ACCELERATION stacks.

statusEffects.durationMs: requested 1000 (raw); halved if the target is enraged, then status duration reductions, rounded; not applied if already blinded or under Rune Protect
statusEffects.effect: a blinded attacker's attack target gets +0.5 dodge chance (the blinded unit misses more)

starBehavior.note: The speed coefficient is indexed by the casting entity's stars; the 3-star (1) and 4-star (2) entries are not reachable by the listed units' bare star counts. Blind duration, delay and geometry do not vary by stars.

record.positionalConditions: The retreat destination depends on the caster's position, the own team's side (blue corners y=0, red corners y=rows-1) and which cells are empty at cast time. Needs a target to cast (requiresTarget true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state of its own; it consumes the ACCELERATION stacks (set to 0), so a following cast starts from fewer stacks (damage uses the then-current speed). Stacks regrow through the passive's OnMove effect.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: damage round(0.25 or 0.5 x speed), x (1 + AP/100), x critPower on a cast crit; Blinded 1000 ms; a retreat to a chosen empty own-side cell 100 ms later; addSpeed(-15 x stacks). Applied: SPE_DEF division and floor of 1 in handleDamage, zero if the target has protect/skydiving/magicBounce, shield absorbed first (takenDamage includes shield damage, section J1); blind skipped if already blinded or Rune Protect, shortened by rage and duration reductions; the speed reset is scaled by Big Eater Belt and clamped; the move swaps with any occupant that arrived in the 100 ms.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: The ACCELERATION passive's trigger conditions in moving-state (which steps call OnMoveEffect) were only located, not traced; the stack count at cast time is not derived here
